articles.title: BlackRock Eyes AES To Deepen Infrastructure And Utility Investment Reach
articles.mainIdea: BlackRock Eyes AES To Deepen Infrastructure And Utility Investment Reach
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: BlackRock Eyes AES To Deepen Infrastructure And Utility Investment Reach. BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners arm and EQT AB are exploring a potential acquisition of utility group AES. The possible deal would add a large regulated utility platform to BlackRock's alternative assets footprint. The transaction would deepen NYSE:BLK exposure to infrastructure and the broader utilities sector.
